label: GO step choosing a2 after landing in S2, boosted by recent non-reward, early in episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (none at D1/D2). Almost all of its mass (94%) is on GO steps where the agent picks a2, and never when the previous trial reached S1 (S2 or first-trial only). Magnitude is largest right after an unrewarded trial and drops with each further consecutive reward (e.g. 0.83 -> 0.10 -> 0 over a run of rewards), so the unit tracks how recently a2/S2 went unrewarded. It also weakens over the episode: there is no firing after about trial 75, which suggests a slow drift in its baseline. Uses only observed history plus the agent own choice (model_act), with no future variables. Dev F1 is 0.68 with mass recall 0.93. Precision is limited because long rewarded runs on a2 hit the threshold inconsistently.
